newsitem.title: USA: AMR Q2 cargo traffic up slightly.
newsitem.headline: AMR Q2 cargo traffic up slightly.

text.p: American Airlines Cargo, a division of the AMR Corp, reported a 0.5 percent increase in cargo traffic for the second quarter.
It said it flew 521.3 million cargo ton miles during the quarter, up from 518.5 million in the same quarter last year. A cargo ton mile represents one ton of cargo carried one mile.
The cargo carrier said freight ton miles for the second quarter rose 1.1 percent from a year earlier, to 424.2 million.
Mail ton miles fell 1.9 percent, to 99 million, it said.
